entities.name: Query protein 485 aa
observations: 485-aa sequence; predicted mass 53.1 kDa and theoretical pI 8.30, calculated from sequence.
Strong homology supports MurE ligase function: best reviewed reference Q39YM4 has 47.4% identity and 92.6% query coverage.
Pfam matches Mur_ligase PF01225, Mur_ligase_M PF08245, and Mur_ligase_C PF02875.

Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent addition of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis; assignment is homology-based, not a direct experiment on this sequence.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase; EC 6.3.2.13; curated homolog annotations indicate Mg2+ dependence and cytoplasmic localization.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent ligation of meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu, forming the peptidoglycan precursor.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE ligase performs a precursor-forming ligation step in bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis.
